title: Ordinary supported Cartier class interfaces
statement: For a scheme Z, a commutative coefficient ring A killed by N, and a closed immersion i:D→Z, let A_D be the constant pro-étale module, and let A_Z(1) be the comparison inverse image of the finite étale roots tensor line [lem-asd-finite-etale-twist-line]. Define GeoCartierClass to be Ext²(i_*A_D,A_Z(1)), using ordinary pro-étale direct image [def-weil-proetale-module-direct-image]. Its simultaneous families range over all positive prime-power exponents and finite coefficient rings annihilated by that power. The source comparison is the closed direct-image adjunction mate followed by the constant comparison; exchange is the mate of inverse-image commutation followed by the pulled-back counit and constant comparison. The finite-line pullback is the site-comparison square followed by the normalized étale transport [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]. The Chern predicate is the Kummer boundary of the dual Cartier ideal, with its actual constant-to-support map. The coefficient predicate requires units normalized on constant sections and pure root tensors, their derived Hom universal properties against every unbounded complex, and the corresponding Ext square. Base change and exponent independence are the literal Ext squares for these specified maps. These definitions assert no existence of a class or compatibility. Underlying interfaces: [def-pc-divisor-line-bundle], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], [sk-def-kummer], [lem-asd-finite-etale-twist-line], [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback], [lem-sc-line-bundle-torsor], [lem-sc-torsor-h1], [lem-amb-kummer-any-base], [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback], [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], [def-weil-proetale-module-direct-image], [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-boundary], [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows].
